Class CrusaderStaticSounds

java.lang.Object
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.sound.CrusaderStaticSounds
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class CrusaderStaticSounds extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Plays synthesized sound effects for stationary crusader animations. Sounds are buffered once and do not require external audio files.
